title: Chapter 431 White Tiger Appears
content:
Chapter 431 White Tiger Appears

When Bai Xu saw the old man drunk coming, he hurriedly thanked: "Thank you for helping me."

He was extremely moved by the old man Zui. After all, he was a scoundrel who wanted to cheat him of the 30,000 Chaos Crystals. If the old man Zui had not intervened, he really didn't know what to do.

After recent days of running around, Bai Xu has gradually changed a little, at least becoming a little more mature.

Faced with Bai Xu's sincere thanks, Old Zui just waved his hand indifferently, "That kind of scum should have ended like this long ago."

"It's you."

The old man drunk suddenly smiled, looked at Bai Xu with interest, and grinned, "I heard that you have rejected Miss Lu Xue."

"ah?"

Bai Xu was slightly stunned and didn't understand it at the first time.

But he soon noticed the meaningful smile of the old man Broken Sword. Suddenly, he knew who Miss Lu Xue was mentioned by the old man Zui.

Thinking of this, Bai Xu hesitated for a while and asked carefully: "Senior, I wonder who Miss Lu Xue?"

The old man Zui stepped forward and patted Bai Xu's strong shoulder, and said seriously: "It's nothing, it's just the daughter of the lord of this wasteland city."

"Oh, I was shocked, I thought,"

“…”

"Shenma?!"

Bai Xu opened his mouth wide, his eyes almost coming out. He never expected that the senior's identity was so terrifying.

At this time, the old man Broken Sword also stepped forward to comfort Bai Xu.

"Boy, everyone has their own choice. Now, it seems that you have found something better, right?"

"I,,,"

Bai Xu was a little dull, and at this moment he didn't know what to say.

But the old man Broken Sword no longer had the intention of reminiscing about the past. It was just a coincidence that he could see Bai Xu here.

"Boy, there will be a date later."

He patted Bai Xu on the shoulder again and the three of them left.

In place, Bai Xu stood in the wind and was in a mess.

At this time, a faint voice came from your wrist: "I didn't expect you to reject the daughter of the city lord. How could I, Hao and Sheng, follow me?"

After hearing Senior Hao's words, Bai Xu was completely irritated.

If he regrets that he can improve his realm, he may be promoted to the Supreme Immortal Class of Heaven at this moment.

It’s a pity that there is no medicine for regret in the world.

Everything is over.

but,,

Bai Xu frowned, then suddenly stretched out, and said excitedly: "My sister followed that senior, and that senior was the daughter of the lord of this city, so she is here too! ”

Although Bai Xu originally thought of becoming strong enough before reuniting with his sister, time waited for no one. The Chaos Realm suddenly had a strong enemy invaded, who knew what the ending would be.

Who will give him time to grow into a strong man?

It's good to see my sister now. Before Bai Xu came, he thought about the possibility of meeting her sister in Huangcheng. Now that he knows Lu Xue's identity, Bai Xu firmly believes in her sister's possibility in Huangcheng.

But, as the deserted city is so big, how can I find my sister?

Bai Xu fell into deep thought.

At this moment, he was suddenly stunned.

"Oh, what do I want to do?"

"The list of geniuses." The bracelet trembled, reminding Bai Xu.

"Damn!"

Bai Xu, who remembered the Tianjiao List, rushed towards the direction of Huangcheng Square.

It has been a while since the release of the Tianjiao List. I have been waiting for so long, but I still haven't seized the opportunity.

Bai Xu didn't know at this moment that he got the surprise because of his accident this time.

Once you enter the Huangcheng Square.

A magnificent voice came to my mind.

That is the news that the Tianjiao List was launched.

The list of geniuses has officially started, and all creatures under ten thousand years of age have the opportunity to make it.

Although Bai Xu looks young, he is a white tiger in the Heavenly Demon Clan. The Heavenly Demon Clan has a long lifespan. Bai Xu, who is the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon, is no less. At this time, he is already six thousand years old. Age is now.

In the Chaos Realm, the Supreme Realm is already a top-notch powerhouse.

The strong men of the Supreme Heaven rarely take action, and they are not visible on weekdays.

And under the Supreme Realm, it is divided into four realms: Creation Realm, Taixu Realm, Prophet Realm, Longevity Realm:

Because Bai Xu debuted late, no one taught him, but with his powerful talent and the awakened bloodline of the Heavenly Demon, he has now reached the Prophet Realm.

As long as he is given a period of time, he will definitely be able to enter the realm of immortality and achieve the supreme success.

He came to the Tianjiao List in a panic. At this moment, the list was already full of places. Bai Xu's face was slightly dark. Looking at the top 100, he said in his heart: I can only make it.

He had already thought of a way. As long as he got the best ranking first, he would definitely become famous in a short period of time, and his sister would definitely hear from him.

Thinking of this, Bai Xu took a deep breath and looked up firmly at the genius list.

Thoughts move slightly.

Bai Xu felt an indescribable aura covering him. The next moment, the surroundings suddenly changed, and Bai Xu suddenly found himself appearing in a huge martial arts field.

And opposite him, a childish boy was staring at him in a daze.

The two teenagers looked at each other from afar, but Bai Xu was even more energetic.

The boy opposite is just a person who is just a mess.

Feeling Bai Xu's breath, the boy in the distance bit his saliva, and a hint of timidity appeared in his eyes.

And at this moment, the light curtain of whether to surrender appeared in front of the young man.

The boy chose to surrender without hesitation.

"this,,"

Bai Xu was slightly stunned by the success of the first game, but after reacting, he quickly chose to continue the challenge.

He wants to play the best ranking before those real geniuses come here.

In this way, Bai Xu entered the selfless ranking, and his ranking began to rise all the way, and soon attracted the group of people watching the fun in the square.

"Huh? What is the origin of this Bai Xu? Why have you never heard of it?"

One person questioned, and everyone around him shook their heads.

At this moment, the list underwent a slight change, and behind the name, there was a little power behind him and a small amount of identity information.

Bai Xu - the Heavenly Demon Clan, the Four Elephants of Heavenly Demon, and the White Tiger.

This sudden change caught everyone present off guard.

Especially the powerful Tian Yao tribe present were stunned when they saw this information and were ecstatic.

The four-elephant white tiger of the Heavenly Demon Clan, who had been looking for for a long time, actually appeared here. It was really hard to find a way out, and there was another village with dark willows and flowers!

"Hurry, please inform the clan leader."

"I have notified you that the clan leader said that the two young masters Qingxuan were already on the way to Huangcheng and would arrive soon."

The demons were excited and began to fantasize about the four heavenly demons working together to bring the heavenly demon clan to a brilliant picture.
